EFFECT: “When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6 …” The gist says “before your unit has fought this phase”. A unit has been selected to fight before it has fought, so the gist also allows a model destroyed after selection but before the unit has fought, which the text excludes. The rest is literal: “When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first)” = “until your unit has fought or the phase ends”. The struck-through ~~DEFF DREAD~~ +3 is left out as the coordinator describes.

fix.gist: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+ it is not removed until your unit has fought or the phase ends.

Text: “your unit does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units” applies to all of the unit’s hit rolls. The gist ties it to the Blast weapons (“Blast weapons can target … with no hit penalty”): narrowed. The mortal wound applies “each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Blast weapon that targets a unit within Engagement Range of your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1 … after all of its attacks have been resolved”. The gist’s “each unmodified hit roll of 1 with them” drops the target condition (so it widens to every Blast attack) and the timing. “(if no other friendly units are)” leaves out what they must not be within: “within Engagement Range of that enemy unit”.

fix.gist: Until the end of the phase, your unit’s Blast weapons can target enemy units within Engagement Range of it (if no other friendly unit is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit) and it has no hit roll penalty for being within Engagement Range; each unmodified hit roll of 1 with a Blast weapon against a unit within Engagement Range of it is 1 mortal wound to your unit, after all its attacks are resolved.
